articles.summary: In order to comply with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA) Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), it’s imperative to shift the focus toward preventing contamination rather than responding to contamination.
articles.title: The Food Safety Modernization Act: From Farm to Table, Keeping Your Food Temperature in Compliance

articles.summary: A recent Fortune article places the annual costs of medical treatment, lost productivity and foodborne-illness-related mortality for affected consumers at $55.5 billion.
articles.title: The FSMA’s Focus on Prevention to Thwart Foodborne Illnesses
